title: Length of a rendered segment
statement: For any segment consisting of a bit string $w$ and a flag indicating whether it is doubled, the length of its rendered bit string equals $2|w|$ when the flag is true and $|w|$ when it is false.
hypotheses_covered: the object is a segment (a bit string together with a Boolean flag)
